reuse.why: linkFintegraAccount goes through the tree's existing ensureBankAccountIsNotLinked and linkBankSyncAccount helpers like the other providers, but the download is written fresh rather than following or sharing the existing provider download pattern.

duplication.why: downloadFintegraTransactions is a condensed restatement of the Akahu/PluggyAi download functions (token, post, error check, mapping) that drops their 'error' branch, timeout and logging instead of sharing them.

placement.why: The link handler sits with the other link handlers in accounts/app.ts, the download in sync.ts and the base URL in server-config.ts.

scope.why: Only what a new provider needs, with no unrelated edits.

maintainability.why: The link side is a short declarative call into shared helpers, but the download now diverges from its siblings in error handling and timeout, and the institution name loses the '?? null' convention the other handlers use.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Linking uses ensureBankAccountIsNotLinked and linkBankSyncAccount; there is no shared download abstraction to bypass.

disguised_duplication.where: downloadFintegraTransactions in packages/loot-core/src/server/accounts/sync.ts restates downloadAkahuTransactions in compressed form (inline objects, no retVal/logging) rather than sharing it.
